message.content:
# Rutina — Layout Adaptation Analysis

## 1. Horizontal space usage at tablet widths

**Mostly a stretched phone column.** At 768px and 960px, the app keeps the exact phone structure — full-width hero, full-width green card, full-width "Satu Langkah" card — just wider. There's no grid or multi-column re-organization of the main content. The only genuine adaptation is the stats row (Rekor Konsistensi / Kebiasaan Aktif / Arus Kas Bersih), which becomes a **3-up card row at 768px** — that's the one place the layout actually uses the wider canvas well.

At 960px the scaling stops entirely: the content column appears capped (content spans ~940px with tiny side gutters of ~15px), so 768 → 960 is essentially "same layout, slightly wider."

## 2. Navigation: phone vs tablet

- **Phone (390px):** full-width bottom bar — 5 items (Beranda, Kebiasaan, Tambah, Keuangan, Kalender) with the green FAB "Tambah" notched into the center.
- **Tablet (768px):** the bottom bar is retained but becomes a **floating pill** — it no longer touches the edges, it's centered and elevated. Still a 5-item bar.
- **960px: this breaks badly.** The nav pill wraps into a **two-row cluster** (Beranda/Kebiasaan/Tambah/Keuangan on the top row, Kalender orphaned on a second row below-left). It also overlaps content — it sits on top of the "Satu Langkah Hari Ini" card, whose text ("Mulai dari satu…", "Pilih hal sederhana yang…") is visibly clipped underneath it. This is the single worst defect across the three screenshots.

## 3. Cards/rows stretching uncomfortably wide — yes

- **"Aktivitas Workspace" card:** at 960px it's a ~940px-wide strip holding one short line of text ("Jejak 7 hari terakhir") on the left and one small badge on the right. Huge empty band in the middle; line length is fine but the whitespace-to-content ratio is poor.
- **"Habit hari ini / 0%" inner card** inside the green hero: ~380px wide at phone, stretched to ~730px at 960px — a two-line card floating in a giant card; looks unbalanced.
- **Hero headline** "Setiap taman dimulai dari satu benih" wraps awkwardly ("satu / benih") at both tablet sizes instead of being allowed to expand or rewrap.
- The **subtitle pill** in the hero ("Pilih satu hal sederhana…") becomes a fixed-width pill that at 960px is **overlapped by the "Lihat perjalanan pohonmu →" link**, which is crowded right next to it — text appears to collide.

## 4. Oversized / misaligned / awkward elements at tablet

- **Floating nav pill at 960px:** wrapped to two rows, overlapping content (covered above — the critical issue).
- **Hero illustration (house, woman with plant):** the woman illustration is cropped/bleeding oddly at 768px and 960px, and at 768px the subtitle pill's text sits under the decorative circles, low contrast.
- **"Satu Langkah" card at 960px:** its decorative woman illustration collides with the heading area and the card itself is partially hidden behind the nav.
- **Avatar "N"** stays a small circular button pinned bottom-left at all sizes; at tablet it awkwardly overlaps the nav pill / card edges (visible at 960px sitting on top of "Satu Langkah" content).

## 5. Where whitespace is wasted

- **Vertical center of the Aktivitas Workspace strip** — ~500px of dead horizontal space between label and badge at 960px.
- **Green hero card:** large empty green area between the left text stack and the right illustration at tablet widths; content doesn't rebalance or gain a second element to fill it.
- **"Satu Langkah" card:** one heading, one line of copy, one button — at 960px it's a ~940px × 200px card that's mostly empty, and partially obscured by the nav anyway.
- **Overall gutters:** only ~15px side margins at 960px — content goes edge-to-edge while internal cards are hollow; the whitespace is in the wrong place (edges too tight, interiors too empty).

## Verdict

Solid phone design; 768px is a passable "wide phone" with a nice floating nav and the one good 3-up stats row; **960px is broken** — the wrapped/overlapping nav pill, colliding hero subtitle/link, and dead-space strips mean a proper tablet treatment (sidebar nav, 2-column content grid, max-width content column) is needed rather than linear stretching.
